main_text.p: סַמָּאֵל Chal. Sammaël, Nomen Angeli maligni, cujus mentio Genef. 3.6. in Targ. Jonath. ubi vocatur Angelus mortis.
סַמָּא סַם Ch. & Syr. Aroma: Venenum Toxicum, & sic plerumque ipsi adjungitur סַמָּא מוֹתָא דמוֹתָא Pulvis lethalis, venenum lethale: Sic Syriac. סַמָּא Mar. 16.18. Jac. 3.8.
סַמְּנִין Chaldaicè, Aromata odorata, Genef. 49. 20. in Jonath.
סַמְמָנִין Ch. Respondet Hebr. שֶׁשׁ, quod Indicum, Colorem Indicum, Minium, exponunt nonnulli.
סַמָּן Ch. Signare, consignare. Ithpehal אִסְתַּמִּין Signatus est, Esth. 5.1. in T. sec.
סִימָן Chald. Signum, σημεῖον. Plur. emph. סִימָנַיָּא Exod. 21.7. in Jonath.
סִימָא Ch. Idem. Plur. סִמָּוּת סִימָן.
סִמָּיִין Chald. Idem. Plur. constr. סִמָּיֵנִי Signa, Vestigia, Jobi 13.27.
סוּמָנִין Ch. Signa, signata, designata loca.
סִמְפוֹנְיָה, סוּמְפַנְיָה Chald. Symphonia, συμφωνία, Dan. 3.15. 5.10. ubi scribitur סִיפַנְיָא, quod Masorethæ legendum docent סוּמְפַנְיָא.
סַמְפּוּרָא Chaldaicè Acies, Acumen. Plural. מְזֹרָג מַלִּי סַמְפּוּרִין Tribulam plenam aciebus, seu dentibus, Jesa. 4.15.
סַמְפּוּרְיָא Chald. Sapphirus, nomen lapidis pretiosi, Exod. 28.18. in Targ. Hierosolym. Alibi legitur סַמְפִּי רִינוּן, ut Deuteron. 4.13. in Jonath. quod idem.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as far as legible; several vowel points and diacritics in the Hebrew/Chaldaic forms are uncertain and may differ from print. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
